steps.text: Heat the oven to 220C fan and put a roasting tin in to heat with it.
Toss the thighs with the oil, oregano, salt, and pepper until they are coated.
Lay them skin side up in the hot tin with the lemon and garlic between them.
Roast until the skin has tightened and taken its first colour.
Spoon the pan juices over the thighs, leaving the skin itself dry.
Rest the tin on the hob for five minutes, then serve straight from it.
